author: Emma (SE)
quote: It did fit my big 16” laptop as well as everything else I bring with me to work!
paraphrase: Bag holds 16-inch laptop plus work items.

author: Stella Ridgway
quote: Excellent quality and easy to clean
paraphrase: Used on weekend away; well made, easy to wipe.

author: Olivia Hanne
quote: they promptly sent another bag, without me having to send back the original product.
paraphrase: Service replaced stained backpack without return; happy with Siena Pro tote too.

author: Louise (GB)
quote: the tote bag inside is fabulous. Beautiful quality and I can now find everything in my bag easily.
paraphrase: Praises packaging and quality; items easy to locate.

author: Consumer (CA)
quote: Well Organized so things aren't floating in space.
paraphrase: Interior layout keeps items from shifting.

author: Aileen Cook
quote: I was so impressed with the quality of the product, the service from Nordace & the delivery service

author: Pamela (US)
quote: It is a well made tote that looks like it costs much more.
paraphrase: Grande Siena Pro tote looks pricier; uses instead of suitcase for short trips.

author: Sabine Schroeder
quote: The cable in my Siena Tote bag did not work, and did not connect to my phone properly.
paraphrase: Siena tote cable failed with Samsung; bought one elsewhere; still likes bag.

author: Miia Hiiri
quote: they’ll send me a replacement foot with no charge what so ever.
paraphrase: Missing base foot on nearly two-year-old tote; free replacement.

author: Tracey S
quote: The best part was that it fit nicely under the seat and I didn’t have to fight for overhead bin space.
paraphrase: Sienna tote fit under seat on work trip.

author: Lynn Suzanne
quote: I packed 2 weeks of clothes, tablet, phone & chargers, extension cord, and knitting project all in the one tote
paraphrase: Fit two weeks of clothes and electronics into one tote.

author: Jeanette
quote: And love the hidden pockets and that i can charge my phone, laptop etc via the tote
paraphrase: Uses tote for travel and work; hidden pockets, charging.

author: Lynda Fife
quote: This is my personal item as I am not taking a carry on.
paraphrase: Uses tote as only travel bag instead of carry-on.
